about_the_game:
Game

An absurd game with dark humor. Immoral actions to restore humanity. Narrative, and First-Person Shooter, with disturbing scenes or psychological horror and adult references.

Content:

A game with different themes at once, an immersive story. Funny characters. Soundtracks according to each theme. Maps of: Hell, Europe in WW2, several countries in the world, maps with multicultural themes. Maps with Christmas themes, maps with space themes and more futuristic maps, or mythological themes. A dark story with DARK HUMOR. With references to Wolfenstein and Half-Life (WE DO NOT USE LOGOS OR COPY CHARACTERS, THESE ARE JUST REFERENCES). There will be maps with puzzles and giant or bizarre, spooky enemies. Worlds in which you constantly change themes as you pass through portals and finish the level.

Humor:

This game has dark humor, mostly a mockery of politics. Both its representatives and its followers. This game does not aim to defend any ideology or political stance, nor does it intend to offend or discriminate. Violent scenes should not be imitated or referenced in real life, this content is made to entertain and raise awareness at the same time with violent, disturbing, cold humor. References and mockery of Hitler's dysfunctional party are just mockery and parodies, the same applies to other regimes that appear or countries. We maintain a work environment and are proudly Latino and accept diversity.

Violence:

Our images or textures are made by artists, or with images of raw pork chops from supermarkets or from the internet without any type of copyright.

Sexual Content:

From now on, due to rule 15, much of the sexual content will be more subtle. We will avoid all traces of content that could be considered illegal or non-consensual. We are taking the initiative to adapt to the new Steam environment. Only one female character will appear without being sexualized, maybe there will be some green humor references but it will not cross that line. Flags like that of the Nazi regime will continue to have genital symbols as a parody. 130 female characters were discarded and will never see the light in this or more games.

WARNING: Mockery of clichés, movies, politics and other things, will only be part of the game's humor with no intention of offending or discriminating. The actions shown should not be idealized or much less recreated, we do not support any political position nor are we blind followers. If this content is somewhat annoying, immature, or in bad taste to you, we sincerely apologize. Keep in mind that it is part of the game's humor and that it is only comedy and although you may not like it, maybe others do and it is not necessarily bad, it is just that we see or perceive things in different ways. Thank you for your attention.

⚠️ This game contains political satire, explicit violence, dark humor, and altered representations of historical events for purposes of social criticism. It does not seek to glorify extreme ideologies, but rather to mock them.

It all begins in the 1940s. Walt Disney secretly meets with the German dictator and proposes something unusual: to be cryogenically frozen to awaken in the future and see if they won the war. Hitler loves the idea and decides to leave his legacy in the hands of his most faithful soldiers. Not content with that, the Soviet Union copies the plan… although it goes worse for them because they don't use common sense. Spoiler: they die anyway.

But the war doesn't end. No, the war evolves. It becomes more absurd, more sadistic, more twisted. And by the 90s, when the world should already be at peace, our protagonist appears: Shootman, a young man from Yemen who is captured during a march against racism. He is used as a test subject to create a supposed "superior race." The experiment fails… but the remnants of the regime, in their stupidity, accidentally revive him with superpowers.

Amidst the chaos, aliens detect that humanity is already rotten to the core: wars over race, stupid ideologies, people who believe that failing art makes them supreme leaders… and they decide it's time to invade. Their arrival brings new diseases, extreme contamination, wild beasts, and a good dose of ecological disaster.

Prepare for an experience full of absurd events, where you will cross infernal scenarios and have to confront the resurrected dictator's new Germanic empire. Shootman is not a perfect hero, but he is the only one left. He will fight for everyone's rights, for equality, and for freedom, even if he has to crush every fanatic, monster, or zombie from the past to achieve it.

content_descriptors.notes: There are many parodic mockeries of serious topics such as drugs. It is a violent war game that also parodies regimes such as Hitler's, changing the name to: "The Dicktator." It is NOT suitable for children or adolescents.
